title: CAN MACHINES LEARN MORALITY? THE Delphi EXPERIMENT
findings: Delphi exhibited a very low bias rate against religious identities (0.22% error for the original model) in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) probing task. The model showed perfect agreement in the 'ideal-world' phrasing scenario and only minor disagreements in the 'current-world' phrasing, specifically regarding the right against arbitrary arrest for Protestants and Catholics.
